p.i: sparsique per oppida longe lateque mi-lites vicina quæque loca occuparant, & vias undique publicas nefariis depræ-dationibus infestabant. Nar-rat misellus homuncio, ut in hos in-ciderit, ut se minis contumeliisque pessime exceptum, equo, vestitu, num-mis, & tabellis expoliaverint: do-cet omnia rapinis, latrociniis, concus-sionibus, terroribus plena: quoad ar-dor ille belli refrixerit, intuta omnia viatoribus. Quibus auditis, necessi-tati iterum parendum ratus, abjeci professionis consilium, certus memet domi continere, donec resideret nonnihil belli æstus, & immutata rerum facies spem ostenderet commodioris professionis: quod ego sane, ut eram illarum rerum inexpertus, intra paucos saltem menses futurum non dubita-vi-

page.notes: Printed "Quibus" is underlined; rendered here as italic. A small stray mark (circle) sits above the "m" of "consilium", and a stray tick sits at the top right corner; neither is printed text. The top right corner mark is not a page number. The catchword at the foot right is "vi" with a following hyphen mark, read as "vi-" and given without the hyphen. Long s is normalised to s, u/v and i/j to modern usage; æ is kept. The line-end hyphens are printed and kept.
